+import base64
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+GOOGLE_VISION_API_URL = "https://vision.googleapis.com/v1/images:annotate"
+
+
+def _load_image_content(image_path: Optional[str] = None, image_bytes: Optional[bytes] = None) -> str:
+    if image_bytes is not None:
+        return base64.b64encode(image_bytes).decode("utf-8")
+    if image_path is None:
+        raise ValueError("image_path or image_bytes is required")
+    with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
+        return base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode("utf-8")
+
+
+def detect_image_text(image_path: Optional[str] = None, image_bytes: Optional[bytes] = None, language_hints: Optional[list[str]] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_VISION_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise EnvironmentError("GOOGLE_VISION_API_KEY is required")
+
+    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
+        "requests": [
+            {
+                "image": {"content": _load_image_content(image_path=image_path, image_bytes=image_bytes)},
+                "features": [{"type": "TEXT_DETECTION"}],
+            }
+        ]
+    }
+    if language_hints:
+        payload["requests"][0]["imageContext"] = {"languageHints": language_hints}
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        GOOGLE_VISION_API_URL,
+        params={"key": api_key},
+        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        data=json.dumps(payload),
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    annotations = data.get("responses", [{}])[0].get("textAnnotations", [])
+    full_text = annotations[0]["description"] if annotations else ""
+    return {"text": full_text, "annotations": annotations, "raw": data}
+

+import base64
+import json
+import os

+from typing import Any, Dict, List
+
+import requests
+
+
+API_URL = "https://vision.googleapis.com/v1/images:annotate"
+
+
+def _load_image_content(image_path: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    if image_path.startswith("http://") or image_path.startswith("https://"):
+        return {"source": {"imageUri": image_path}}
+    with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
+        encoded = base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode("utf-8")
+    return {"content": encoded}
+
+
+def detect_image_labels(image_path: str, max_results: int = 10) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_VISION_API_KEY") or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("Missing GOOGLE_CLOUD_VISION_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY")
+
+    payload = {
+        "requests": [
+            {
+                "image": _load_image_content(image_path),
+                "features": [{"type": "LABEL_DETECTION", "maxResults": max_results}],
+            }
+        ]
+    }
+    response = requests.post(f"{API_URL}?key={api_key}", json=payload, timeout=60)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    annotations = data["responses"][0].get("labelAnnotations", [])
+    return [
+        {
+            "description": item.get("description"),
+            "score": item.get("score"),
+            "mid": item.get("mid"),
+        }
+        for item in annotations
+    ]
+
+

+    if len(sys.argv) < 2:

+    print(json.dumps(detect_image_labels(image_path, max_results=max_results), indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
